headline: Waist-to-head windswell, but the wind's on it today — better days are coming.
today: Plenty of size at 2-3ft-plus on a good E angle, but it's cross-on to onshore most of the day with a short 4-5s period. Evening lightens to 6mph E if you want a glassy sunset dribble. Save your energy for later in the week.

daysToWatch.note: The pick of the week — 2.5-3ft E at a real 6-7s period with cross-off NNW at dawn. Clean and organized, worth the 1.5-hour drive. Shortboard or fish on the early tide.
Biggest reading anywhere, 3-4ft on a prime E angle, but cross-on NE all day keeps it bumpy. Still ridable and worth a look if Monday doesn't line up.
Chest-high ESE with cross-off SW wind — cleanest of the early-week days if you can't wait.
